# Copier options

Source: `template/copier.yml`.

## Meta

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `_min_copier_version` | `9.4.0` |
| `_answers_file` | `.copier-answers.yml` |
| `_subdirectory` | `frontend` if `stack=frontend` else `backend` |

Validators: `project_slug`, `first_service` → `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]+$`

## Shared

| Question | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `stack` | `backend` | Subdirectory selection |
| `project_name` | `My Platform` | Human title |
| `project_slug` | from name | Machine name |
| `ai_tools` | `[claude, cursor]` | Claude hooks / Cursor rules |

## Backend

| Question | When | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `repo_layout` | backend | `monorepo` | monorepo \| polyrepo_service \| polyrepo_kit |
| `architecture` | monorepo | `monolith` | monolith \| microservices |
| `first_service` | not kit | `core-api` | First service name |
| `messaging` | not kit | `none` | none \| kafka |
| `platform_profile` | not kit | **`saas`** | saas \| api |
| `repo_manager` | monorepo | `none` | none \| nx \| moon |
| `kit_git_url` | polyrepo_service | GitHub placeholder | https/ssh only (no scp form) |
| `kit_version` | polyrepo_service | `v0.1.0` | Git tag pin |
| `python_version` | backend | `3.12` | 3.12 \| 3.13 |

## Frontend

| Question | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `api_base_url` | **`http://localhost:8001/api/v1`** | Vite `VITE_API_BASE_URL` (include API prefix) |
| `auth_mode` | **`saas`** | saas (real IdP) \| dev (mock principal) |
| `default_locale` | `en` | en \| ja |

## Derived flags

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `is_microservices` | polyrepo_service **or** monorepo microservices |
| `has_kit_source` | kit in-repo (not polyrepo_service) |
| `is_saas` | `platform_profile == saas` |
